adminLists.title: Lists
adminLists.subtitle: The controlled vocabularies the rest of the app picks from. Pick a list, then click a row to edit it.
adminLists.emptyDescription: Add the first entry and it becomes available everywhere the app offers this choice.
adminLists.archiveCopyCategories: Archiving hides this category from new-part pickers. Parts already in it keep their category.
adminLists.archiveCopyColors: Archiving hides this colour from order and build pickers. Bikes and orders already using it keep it.
adminLists.archiveCopyCoatings: Archiving hides this finish from the colour form. Colours already using it keep it.
adminLists.archiveCopySegments: Archiving hides this segment from customer forms. Customers already in it keep their segment.
adminLists.archiveCopyFamilies: Archiving hides this family from the template form. Templates already in it keep their family.
adminLists.archiveCopyHsCodes: Archiving hides this code from new-part pickers. Tariffs already snapshotted onto purchase order lines are untouched — cost basis is frozen at purchase.
adminLists.archiveCopyLocations: Archiving hides this location from stock forms. The primary location cannot be archived — make another one primary first.
